{{Quote|&hellip;Baris, Red, Kef&hellip;|Skirata and Vau mention Baris in their mourning|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Baris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="Order 66" /> who was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. They were born and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]<ref name="SWE" /> as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Order 66" /> which raged between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Baris was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the war and was later mourned, along with many other dead clone [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], by the Mandalorian training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="Order 66" /> Like all clones, Baris stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baris was mentioned in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', the fourth novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Order 66" />
